# Precursor Labs

> Research on the organizing principles and infrastructure for collective intelligence.

Precursor Labs (precursorlabs.org) is a research company studying the organizing
principles and infrastructure for collective intelligence.

## Writing

- Blog: https://precursorlabs.substack.com/
- X / Twitter: https://x.com/precursorlabs

## About

We believe the next generation of autonomous systems will need to coordinate
with humans and agents, reason in dynamic environments, and allocate resources
under uncertainty.

We are engineers, financiers, and company builders focusing on three areas:

- Multi agent systems: why specialized AI systems dominate stationary
  environments while frontier LLMs still struggle with dynamic social tasks like
  negotiation, sales, persuasion, investing, and fundraising.
- AI buildout and market structure: how capital markets, compute, energy, GPU
  depreciation and project finance shape the rate and direction of
  AI development.
- Decision-making infrastructure: how verification, trust, reward modeling and
  market design shape coordination between humans, agents, and organizations.

We are especially interested in partners working on interactive learning,
multi-agent RL, AI infrastructure, compute finance and market design.
